messages:
Nina (Prod): Heads-up - competitor rolled a "performance tier" yesterday. Sales are getting asks for a toggle + pricing caps. We need to decide parity vs leverage for a differentiator.
Omar (PM): Quick framing: parity = faster deal flow but shallow product; differentiator = slower time-to-market but stronger positioning. Which metric do we optimize for this quarter?
Jon (Sales): Short-term we need stops in the funnel. Procurement teams want a contractual cap and an admin toggle. They don't require console polish, just a reliable promise.
Faye (Eng): Tech reality: an admin toggle that routes to a quantized/model variant is ~3 dev-days if we reuse existing routing rules. Full quality-mode UI + per-route presets needs more work (eval harness + rollout infra).
Ivy (CS): From onboarding: customers will expect clear guidance on which customer flows are safe to route to cheaper models. Suggest a one-page checklist and a sample test harness for customers to run. Cuts support tickets.
Pri (Design): If we ship a minimal toggle, UI copy must be explicit: "Cost-optimized mode (may reduce accuracy)" with examples and links to the checklist. No ambiguous words like "fast" alone.
Nina (Prod): Proposal: two-step path. Step 0 (immediate): offer pilot program — Managed Config + legal-approved billing language + customer checklist. Step 1 (Q): invest in Quality Modes product with telemetry, per-route defaults, and evaluated model bundles.
Omar (PM): Acceptance criteria for Step 0 pilot: (A) deployable Managed Config for pilot accounts, (B) pilot run for 7 days with daily quality checks, (C) documented rollback procedure, (D) billing language approved.
Faye (Eng): Engineering gating: must validate quantized variant across the pilot prompt set with automated diff checks. If regression > 5% on defined metrics -> block. Need model in catalog and canary support.
Jon (Sales): Pilot customers ready: FinServe and RetailCo. They asked for explicit SLA on rollback and a named support contact.
Ivy (CS): I'll prepare the customer prompt set and a triage doc for the pilot. Also prepare canned responses for common regression reports.
Pri (Design): I'll produce the minimal admin panel mock + tooltip by mid-week.
infra-bot: Canary route created for project "pilot-cost-mode" at 2790011130 - 1% traffic to quantized-x64 variant.
Nina (Prod): Timeline: 3 weeks for pilot (docs + Managed Config + validation). If pilot metrics meet thresholds, we prioritize full Quality Modes next quarter.
Omar (PM): Metrics to evaluate pilot: p95 latency improvement >= 15%, cost saving >= 12%, customer-reported quality regressions <= 4% on pilot sample, no legal billing incidents.
Faye (Eng): Risk callouts: mislabeling could cause production incidents; default must remain OFF for orgs with compliance flags. Also need a clear telemetry tag to attribute regressions to pilot routing.
Jon (Sales): I'll secure the signed pilot agreements and confirm rollback SLAs.
Nina (Prod): Action list: Omar write pilot acceptance doc, Faye scope validation task, Pri mock UI, Ivy assemble prompts, Jon onboard pilots, Nina coordinate legal/comms. Meet Friday for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
